DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-DRACONIC_BLOODLINE_REL:
ACT1: Gain 12 max HP.
ACT2: Gain 1 [gold]flight[/gold], refreshes when resting.
ACT3: Once per turn, after playing 4 [gold]Element[/gold] cards, gain 12 [gold]Block[/gold].
Draconic ancestral blood flows through you.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.descr:
ACT1: When a [gold]Spellslot[/gold] reaches 0, add a random spell 
from your draw pile into your hand.
ACT2: Gain [gold]Potency[/gold] based on the amount of Status cards in your deck.
ACT3: Generating a Status grants 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.flavo: The power of the weave cannot be mastered, it is unpredictable
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-WILD_MAGIC_RELIC.title: Wild Magic
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.d:
ACT1: Once per combat, when [gold]Metamagic[/gold] reaches 0, gain 2 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
ACT2: Heal 5hp when the last kill in an encounter is from Spell attack damage.
ACT3: Playing a [gold]Scrolled[/gold] spell or a spell affected by your [gold]Metamagic[/gold] you draw 1 card.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-LUNAR_SORCERER_RELIC.f: Power from the heavens, right in your veins!
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BATTLE_MASTER_RELIC.de:
ACT1: At the start of your turn, select a [gold]Maneuver[/gold].
ACT2: At the end of your turn, select a card to [gold]Retain[/gold] for a turn.
ACT3: After playing [gold]Action Surge[/gold], gain a [gold]Maneuver[/gold].
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-BATTLE_MASTER_RELIC.fl: He knows what kind of thing you are..
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ECHO_KNIGHT_RELIC.desc:
ACT1: After using [gold]Second Wind[/gold], your next attack is played twice.
ACT2: At the start of combat, play the bottom card of your draw pile.
ACT3: After playing [gold]Action Surge[/gold], put a copy of the next card you play into your draw pile.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-ECHO_KNIGHT_RELIC.flav: In and Out. In and Out.
ACT1: Gain half-caster spellslots. At the start of combat, select 3 of 9 common or uncommon [gold]Spells[/gold] to add to your draw pile.
ACT2: Drawing a [gold]Spell[/gold] grants 5 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
ACT3: After playing a spell, gain a random enemy[gold]Vulnerable[/gold]
A little bit of magic can't hurt.
